title: Ummat Nay Vich Sajday Day, Tawheed Tay Vaar
body:
Ummat Nay Vich Sajday Day, Tawheed Tay Vaar Chalaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Allah De Ahle No Kufiya Nay
Pardays Yateem Banaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Eh Ehsa Ahdal Duniya Day
Jiday Samanay Adal Vee Juk Javay
Jinay Kah Kay Zarab Vee Katil No
Hey Apna Jahm Pilaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jidee Ik Zarbat Vee Bahri Eh
Saqlain Dee Kul Ibadat Toow
Kulay Emaan Day Kabbay Nu
Kalamago Ahn Giraya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiday Sadkay Bach Tawheed Gayee
Atay Kalama Paak Muhammad Dah
Uss Noor Day Paak Khazanay Dah
Vich Masjid Khoon Bahaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jidi Naam Di Paak Shahadat Toun
Ahzaan Namaz Vich Parday Oh
Uday Puthar Nay Nokay Nizah Thay
Mumtaz Quran Sunaya
